product_family: Voice AI infrastructure platform: real-time and pre-recorded speech-to-text APIs, voice agent APIs, speech understanding, guardrails, and LLM gateway routing. Enterprise-grade infrastructure serving developers and enterprises.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: AssemblyAI follows internal security controls, policies, and procedures upheld by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 Coverage expanded to include all Trust Service Criteria (security, availability, integrity and privacy controls). Renewed February 3, 2025.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 Certification successfully achieved, validating sophisticated approach to protecting enterprise data and managing information security risks. Announced February 3, 2025.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR third-party assessment completed with documented compliance testing of security controls. EU Data Residency available (Dublin, Ireland). EU-U.S., UK-U.S., and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) certified.

certifications.name: HIPAA / Business Associate Agreement
certifications.proof_quote: AssemblyAI is a Business Associate under HIPAA and offers standard BAA to paid customers. Data under BAA is not used for model training. BAA available at www.assemblyai.com/legal/business-associate-agreement. As of Nov 26, 2024, BAA customers have 3-day TTL on transcripts.

certifications.name: PCI DSS 4.0 Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: PCI-DSS 4.0 Level 1 certified as of March 31, 2025. Upgraded from previous PCI-DSS 3.2.1 certification. Latest Attestation of Compliance available in Trust Center.

privacy.ai_training_note: By default, AssemblyAI uses customer data (including audio transcripts) to train AI/ML models for service improvement and benchmarking. Paid customers can opt out by emailing data-opt-out@assemblyai.com; free users cannot opt out. When BAA is signed, customer data is explicitly NOT used for model training. Zero data retention option available for LLM Gateway with Anthropic and Google inference models when BAA is executed.
privacy.data_region: US (primary); EU data residency available (Dublin, Ireland) via self-serve API parameters

security.name: Data retention for BAA customers
security.value: 3-day TTL (auto-delete); zero retention with LLM Gateway + Anthropic/Google models

security.name: Data protection agreements
security.value: DPA with standard clauses; EU-U.S., UK-U.S., Swiss-U.S. DPF certified

security.name: Data subject rights
security.value: VeraSafe appointed as representative for EU/UK residents

products.name: Pre-recorded Speech-to-Text API
products.data_scope: Customer uploads audio; transcripts returned; by default trained on unless opt-out or BAA signed
products.notes: Universal-3.5 Pro and Universal-2 models. Supports 99 languages. Includes guardrails for PII redaction and content moderation.

products.name: Realtime Speech-to-Text API
products.data_scope: Streaming audio; transcripts in real-time; subject to same training policies
products.notes: Universal-3.5 Pro Realtime, Universal-Streaming, Whisper-Streaming. Unlimited concurrent streams.

products.name: Voice Agent API
products.data_scope: Voice conversations; subject to training policies
products.notes: Production-ready voice agents with turn detection and interruption handling.

products.name: Speech Understanding API
products.data_scope: Audio input; extracts speaker ID, sentiment, chapters, summaries
products.notes: Advanced NLP on audio; subject to training policies.

products.name: LLM Gateway
products.data_scope: LLM prompts and outputs; zero retention with BAA + Anthropic/Google
products.notes: Routes between GPT, Claude, Gemini, community models. Built-in fallback handling.

products.name: Guardrails
products.data_scope: Inline PII redaction and content moderation
products.notes: Prevents sensitive data from reaching logs or downstream LLMs.

compare.pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go; free tier available (limited, no opt-out); paid plans with no concurrency limits or throttles
compare.data_residency: US default; EU (Dublin) on-demand; no other regions announced
